items.description: If you laid every American who died from COVID-19 in a circle around Trump Tower, this is how big it would be. This mashup uses the CoronaTracker API to visualize COVID19 data.
Google Map of strip clubs across the United States. Adult content, Not Safe For Work, NSFW.
Use this album maker to build an album and a slideshow of your Flickr photos. It can generate HTML code for you to embed to your blog or web site.
Real time travel information for Leeds, UK.
Auto-translates as you type. Set the language, or let it detect the language for you.
Speed Dial Group Messaging allows you to quickly get in touch with your group. Make one phone call, record your message and it is sent out to your entire group by voice, email and text message.
Thelaw.tv now has a click-to-call button to call a lawyer immediately from their website using Twilio Client.
Google Maps mashup of community submitted hotel prices.
BedMap is an interactive hotel map with detailed pricing comparisons and help options. Search more than 90,000 available hotels and book a room instantly.

An online portal to over 15,000 public parks and natural areas in California, from neighborhood parks to wilderness areas. Has links to agencies, transit/driving, and 3D views in Google Earth and Bing.

Visual Traceroute is a web application that enables users to trace the path packets take through the Internet, by entering the URL. This application uses ipinfo.io API for geolocation and ISP details.
Real-time traffic and incidences of road issues in Spain, including information from fixed and mobile radar.
Auto Parts and Accessories comparison shopping. Built using the Shopping.com API.
Molamp is a really cool way of discovering and playing music. Search for an artist and Molamp returns not only videos from that artist but also recommendations of others to listen to.
A community to search, rate, and review local restaurants or find a new place to eat.
Provides a comprehensive list of places in Calgary, organized by categories. Find driving directions, phone numbers, etc. You can also email Map Views to friends.
TubeSpy is an application that shows the videos being watched on YouTube as they are being watched.

San Diego School Pal is the easiest way to see San Diego's school districts and their associated levels of crime. We combine a school district map with the 2011 San Diego crime database and Megan's Law statistics. Browse across a map view of San Diego, combined with overlay regions for each of the school districts, covering elementary, high school, and unified. Enter your address to search and locate your own school district or browse the list to get statistics across the city. Share your opinion and thoughts about any San Diego school district with the built-in commenting system, and help others find the best one for their needs.
The Daily Top Five list in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year presents a new top five list compiled from sports, music, films, society, and more.
Simply text #selection to see it appearing on the web page in real time!
Connected to Us creates a communication system using the hardware your team members and customers already own.
